subject.title: fix(gateway): add per-request cancellation to prevent late node.invoke dispatch

question: Should this repair add negotiated per-request cancellation now, or be narrowed to disconnect-only hardening while the canonical timeout issue remains open?
rationale: The canonical security report requires timeout, caller abort, and connection close, but the current patch can observe only connection close; selecting the protocol boundary requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Add request cancellation
options.body: Extend the Gateway lifecycle so client timeout and abort reach the server, covering timeout, pre-abort, disconnect, and allow-versus-cancel races.

options.title: Narrow to disconnect only
options.body: Retitle and document the PR as disconnect hardening while leaving the canonical timeout work open for a separate protocol change.

recommendation.title: Add request cancellation
recommendation.body: Extend the Gateway lifecycle so client timeout and abort reach the server, covering timeout, pre-abort, disconnect, and allow-versus-cancel races.

likelyOwner.reason: He defined the canonical lifecycle and security requirements and has the strongest history across the affected Gateway paths.
